_comment: Thresholds for the deterministic rubric pre-flight (P04). FAIL-capable metrics: fleschEase (breakdown), transferMin, memorableCleanMin, plus the W2 cardQuality lengthTell SHORTEST-side (lengthTellShortestMax) and practiceFloor gates. tellRateMax is ADVISORY (warn-only) as of WP-402 / ledger L-14 D-9(a): the 0.20 value is RETAINED as a diagnostic warn ceiling but NO LONGER blocks. Rationale: it double-counted the cardQuality lengthTell uniquely-longest signal and contradicted the owner corpus — the reference-standard exemplar runs 79% key-longest, the top-10 owner packages average 0.456, and a 0.20 BLOCKING gate false-positive-failed 1718/1903 chapters across 131/140 shipped book-packages/*.v21.json. The genuine key-length defect is the SHORTEST side, which cardQuality.lengthTellShortestMax=4 still BLOCKS (the-power-of-moments v24 runs 5-8/9 -> FAIL). REMOVAL/TIGHTEN CONDITION: only re-promote tellRateMax to a blocking gate if a future owner-corpus recalibration shows uniquely-longest keys are no longer the house norm AND a fresh zero-false-positive sweep over book-packages/*.v21.json passes at the chosen cutoff. fkGrade is ADVISORY (warn-only): review calibration on the real catalog showed the top books read easier than the band (atomic-habits breakdown FK ≈ 4.2 → an FK-min gate would fail 20/20 of its chapters), so the ease band is the enforceable readability ruler and FK is descriptive. House-tic and nominalization are DIAGNOSTIC (warn-only). Rates here are FRACTIONS in [0,1] (tellRate/transferRatio), not score.py's 0..100 percentages. Do NOT tighten a fail band or flip a warn-only metric to fail without a zero-false-positive calibration against book-packages/*.v21.json (see docs/v24/w2-card-preflight-calibration.md §(d)).
_cardQualityComment: W2 (plan §WS5) deterministic per-chapter CARD-QUALITY gates, calibrated against the top-5 owner-scored packages (all pass) and the-power-of-moments v24 (echo flags 4 known lifts; shortest length-tell FAILs at 51%). echoKeyThreshold=5 is the zero-FP tier (the >=4 tier admits canonical-principle-key FPs); echoDistractorCeiling=4 requires all distractors below a 4-token echo. lengthTellShortestMax=4 and lengthTellLongestMax=9 are per-chapter caps out of 9 questions; the shortest cap is the active gate (top-5 peak at 4/9, POM v24 runs 5-8/9), the longest cap is calibrated to pass the top-5 (whose keys are the uniquely-longest choice up to 9/9 by long-standing house norm) while keeping the symmetric mechanism in place. See docs/v24/w2-card-preflight-calibration.md.
